summary: Honest dry-stop, re-confirmed post-J-09: no hold-out survivor (no pnl-scan.json; sole registered candidate candidate-faster-warmup already screened a non-survivor; champion still v1/default; PnL ledger still 1 row). All 7 datasets are keyless PG_SIP_REFERENCE slices of one symbol/one 10-min regime with n=1 per split (< config min 5) and no independent real hold-out; sim is not a dataset source and real diversity needs Alpaca (SOURCE_HISTORICAL). The only dataset-enabling idea is already in the backlog rejected as structurally infeasible keyless, and the sole structural surface idea (UI/REST for the J-09 edge report) renders only the honest empty finding until real data exists. Resume when the operator registers real-scale SOURCE_HISTORICAL datasets (hold-out n>=5) or the champion changes.
